cases.case_name: Crescent Educational & Charitable Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek stone-crushing firm par department ne Rs.1 crore section 68 (unexplained cash credits) ka addition lagaya aur Rs.94.86 lakh expenses disallow kiye.
cases.issue: Kya section 68 ka addition aur expenses ka disallowance sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne dono additions hata diye. Tribunal ne mana ki department ka case proof nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar department koi cash credit ya heavy expense add kar raha hai, toh proper explanation/record dena zaruri hai. Tribunal ne bina pakke proof ke addition hata diya.

cases.case_name: SR Blue Metals Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek business par department ne Rs.32.56 lakh ka commission, Rs.1 crore loan aur Rs.62.30 lakh lorry tips disallow kiye the.
cases.issue: Kya ye saare expenses aur loan addition banate hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne commission, loan aur lorry tips ke sare additions hata diye. Tribunal ko department ka case majboot nahi laga.
cases.takeaway: Unusual expenses ya loan ka addition/proof chahiye toh relevant document ready rakho. Tribunal ne sari disallowance hata di jab department case solid nahi tha.

cases.facts: Doctor ka professional income tha, jisme unhone 50% profit declare kiya tha. Baaki grounds pe kuch nahi bola gaya.
cases.issue: Kya section 44ADA ke andar 50% professional income show karna allowable hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne allow kiya ki 50% receipts ko hi taxable income mana jayega. Baaki grounds tribunal ne entertain nahi kiye.
cases.takeaway: Professional service wale Aadmi (doctors/vakil etc.) 44ADA ke andar apni gross receipts ka 50% hi income maan sakte hai, detailed expense records ki zarurat nahi.

cases.case_name: IL & FS Pradip Refinery Water Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: AY 2015-16 ke liye reassessment notice 31.07.2022 ko bheja gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment notice time-bar ke baad bheja gaya hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola notice time-barred hai (muddati samay ke baad), isliye reassessment ki karvai radd kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar assessment/reassessment notice bahut der se aata hai, toh time-bar rule check karo. Time ke baad aane wala notice radd ho sakta hai.

cases.facts: Assessment mein cash deposit addition lagayi gayi thi aur penalty bhi lagayi gayi thi. Revenue ne usko challenge kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit addition ko hataana aur penalty ko maaf karna sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne Revenue ki appeal kharij ki. Cash deposit ka addition hatane aur penalty relief ko barkarar rakha.
cases.takeaway: Cash deposit pe addition aur penalty tab nahi tikti jab assessee munasab explanation de de. ITAT ne yeh stand uphold kiya.

cases.case_name: Rekha Corporation Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company par ₹2.38 crore ke unsecured loans ko unexplained bolke addition laga di gayi thi. Sath mein ₹1,00,268 PF/ESI expenses ka bhi issue tha.
cases.issue: Kya ye unsecured loan wala addition sahi tha, aur PF/ESI expenses disallow ho sakte hai kya?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 68 ka addition hata diya lekin PF/ESI disallowance ko barkarar rakha.
cases.takeaway: Loan lene par proper documentation zaruri hai. Agar PF/ESI challan late bharoge toh uska deduction reject ho sakta hai.

cases.issue: CIT(A) ne ex parte order pass kiya bina assessee ki baat sune.
cases.held: ITAT ne order set aside kar diya aur appeal wapas bhej di fresh hearing ke liye, taki dono parties properly sun sake.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi order mein bina sunwayi ex parte decide ho jaye to uske khilaf appeal karo - proper hearing ka right hai.

cases.case_name: Harsh Jindal Pranshu Goel Vs ITO
cases.issue: GST portal se bogus purchase ka data milne par reopening kiya gaya aur issue merits par CIT(A) ko bheja gaya.
cases.held: ITAT ne mana ki GST data reopening ke liye kaafi hai, lekin merits par CIT(A) decide karega.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST portal par aapka transaction suspicious dikhe to reopening ho sakta hai, isliye purchase evidence strong rakhna chahiye.

cases.issue: CIT(A) ne additional evidence allow kiya lekin AO ki report ka intezaar nahi kiya, seedha order pass kar diya.
cases.held: ITAT ne addition restore kar diya, keh diya ki AO ki remand report ke bina order nahi pass ho sakta jab naye evidence aaye.
cases.takeaway: Agar case mein naya evidence adduce karo to AO ki remand report zarur aani chahiye, bina uske order galat maana ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: India Kawasaki Motors Private Limited Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Section 68 ke tahat trade payables ko bogus bolke ₹1.5 crore add kiya gaya tha.
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki payables genuine trade transactions the, isliye Section 68 apply nahi hoga aur addition delete kar di.
cases.takeaway: Aapke trade payables genuine business transactions proof ho jaayein, to Section 68 ki addition nahi ruk sakti.

cases.case_name: Underwater Services Company Ltd. Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Related party ko charter hire payment lower than market rate par diya, Revenue ne disallow kiya tha aur addition 153A mein ki thi.
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki comparable rates se kam charge kiya gaya aur records mein incriminating material nahi tha, isliye addition delete ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Related party transactions ka market comparability proof ho to TP aur 153A dono mein relief mil sakta hai, records proper rakhna zaruri hai.

cases.issue: GST registration retrospectively cancel kar diya bina proper notice ya SCN mein retrospective mention kiye.
cases.held: High Court ne retrospective GST registration cancellation ko quash kar diya, lekin fresh SCN jane diya.
cases.takeaway: Aapka GST registration bina clear notice ya SCN ke retrospectively cancel ho to High Court jane ka option hai, process ki proper compliance hona zaruri hai.
